title: :emoji: Get Growing: 2026 Seed Swap
content: The northern hemisphere may be chilly now, but spring will be here sooner than you think! That means it's a great time to join the 2026 Seed Swap, hosted by Bunglegirl! if you've got seeds to share, seeds you're searching for, or just curiosity about growing from scratch, this thread is a lovely place to dig in and see what's sprouting.
author: Brandon Blatcher
